notes: BIRTHPLACE CORRECTED (research 2026-07-03): baptized 18 Mar 1620 at LOCKINGTON, LEICESTERSHIRE, England (where his father Robert Mansfield married in 1613 and the children were baptized) — not "Norfolk, England" as the export has it. Norfolk (Blofield, near Norwich) is where his father Robert was himself baptized in 1590, one generation earlier; this looks like a generation-conflation artifact, Robert's birthplace copied onto Andrew's record. Sources: WikiTree Mansfield-224/Mansfield-221; Geni.

MOTHER CORRECTED; PARENTS INCOMPLETE ON THIS RECORD: Andrew's mother was ELIZABETH KETTLE (m. Robert Mansfield, Lockington, Leicestershire, 10 Feb 1613), not "Grace Elizabeth (Townsend) Mansfield, Mayfield." That garbled compound name looks like a merge of (a) Elizabeth Kettle, Andrew's actual mother, with (b) "Townsend," one of two competing unproven maiden-name guesses (Townsend vs Gedney) for BETHIAH, Andrew's own first wife and Deborah's mother — not his mother — plus (c) an unexplained "Mayfield" with no source found. This record also omits father Robert Mansfield entirely (present on the duplicate record I182541966193); both parents should read Robert Mansfield + Elizabeth Kettle. Sources: WikiTree Mansfield-221/Kettle-568; Geni; Find a Grave #116548927.
